text: {"lessons":["I should judge each stock by its future prospects, not whether it is above or below my personal purchase price; avoiding the discomfort of admitting a mistake can keep me holding a poor investment.","Selling positions that are up just because they show a gain can leave me with a biased portfolio; I should apply the same clear criteria to winners and laggards.","I should review my overall portfolio and risk regularly rather than treating each stock as a separate account or letting infrequent check-ins replace a deliberate plan."]}
